description: Twenty-question benchmark covering two local PDFs, including answerable and unanswerable questions.
documents: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf

questions.question: What are the flat cancellation charges for confirmed Executive Class and AC Chair Car tickets cancelled more than 48 hours before departure?
questions.expected_answer: ₹240 plus GST per passenger for Executive Class and ₹180 plus GST per passenger for AC Chair Car.

questions.question: What cancellation charge applies to confirmed tickets cancelled between 48 and 12 hours before departure?
questions.expected_answer: 25% of the fare, subject to the applicable minimum cancellation charge, plus GST.

questions.question: What cancellation charge applies when a confirmed ticket is cancelled between 12 and 4 hours before departure?
questions.expected_answer: 50% of the fare, subject to the applicable minimum cancellation charge, plus GST.

questions.question: What happens when all passengers on a waitlisted ticket remain waitlisted after first charting?
questions.expected_answer: The ticket is automatically cancelled and the full refund is credited without cancellation deduction.

questions.question: What is the cancellation charge for an online cancellation of a waitlisted ticket?
questions.expected_answer: ₹20 plus GST per passenger, provided cancellation occurs up to four hours before scheduled departure.

questions.question: What is the refund condition for partially confirmed party or family e-tickets cancelled after first charting?
questions.expected_answer: Full refund for confirmed passengers without cancellation deduction, subject to online cancellation or TDR filing for all passengers after first charting and up to 30 minutes before departure.

questions.question: What is the TDR filing deadline when a train is running more than three hours late and the passenger does not travel?
questions.expected_answer: Before the actual departure time at the boarding station.

questions.question: What is the TDR filing deadline for a train terminated short of its destination?
questions.expected_answer: Up to 72 hours after the scheduled arrival at the passenger's destination.

questions.question: Which side of a two-way road must vehicles use in India?
questions.expected_answer: Vehicles must travel on the left side of the road.
questions.source_document: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf

questions.question: From which side should a vehicle overtake, and where is overtaking prohibited?
questions.expected_answer: Overtaking should be from the right. It is prohibited on curves, bridges, narrow stretches, and near pedestrian crossings.
questions.source_document: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf

questions.question: What should motorists do when an emergency vehicle approaches?
questions.expected_answer: Yield the right of way and move to the side of the road to allow unobstructed passage.
questions.source_document: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf

questions.question: What are the horn restrictions in designated Silence Zones?
questions.expected_answer: Horn use is prohibited in designated Silence Zones. Loud, multi-toned, and musical air horns are also banned.
questions.source_document: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf

questions.question: What are the minimum light-transmission requirements stated for car windows?
questions.expected_answer: At least 70% for the windscreen and rear window, and at least 50% for side windows.
questions.source_document: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf

questions.question: Who must wear helmets on a two-wheeler according to the document?
questions.expected_answer: Both the rider and pillion rider must wear BIS/ISI-compliant protective helmets with the straps securely fastened.
questions.source_document: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf

questions.question: Which documents must a driver present when requested by an authorized official?
questions.expected_answer: Driving License, Registration Certificate, Certificate of Insurance, and Pollution Under Control certificate.
questions.source_document: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf

questions.question: What BAC level is identified as an offense for drunk driving, and what is the stated maximum imprisonment for a first offense?
questions.expected_answer: Blood alcohol concentration exceeding 30 mg per 100 ml of blood, with imprisonment of up to six months for a first offense.
questions.source_document: Traffic Rules and Regulations in India.pdf
